text: Look at your “enemy” until they disappear. Choose a person who evokes some rejection in you. Find their portrait on social networks, and look at it for a long time—10 minutes, or maybe you will need an hour or even several days. Do not analyze. Just look until the protective layers of your ego become thin and you see a living, interesting person. And then the most interesting thing will begin to happen—your heart will open, and the “enemy” will disappear. As a result of this practice, your relationship with this person will radically change.
